brief: A webcam eye-gaze communication tool for people who have lost speech. It must feel warm, dignified and calm, never clinical, and read clearly at app-icon and favicon size.
criteria: Success: unlike the usual blue medical or eye-icon marks, recognisable at 24 px, works in one colour and reversed, says 'seeing becomes saying' in one glance.

concepts.name: Eye Bubble
concepts.idea: An eye that is also a speech bubble: seeing becomes saying.
rationale: One idea in one glance: the product is gaze turned into voice.
The warm coral pupil is the point of gaze, the one thing the user chooses.
Avoids the usual blue-and-clinical look of assistive tech: teal and coral feel human.
Reversed tile version stays readable at 16 px where the full-colour ring would blur.

recommendation: Use the full-colour symbol on light backgrounds, the reversed symbol on teal or dark, and the tile version for favicons and app icons.
next_steps: Add to the VisualEyes app header and demo video
